Install SweepMyTV from your phone

You’ll need an Android TV or Google TV device running Android 8.0 or newer that allows APK installation. Keep your phone and TV on the same Wi‑Fi.

  1. Download SweepMyTV on your phone.
    Download SweepMyTV for TV

    On iPhone, look for the downloaded file in the Files app under Downloads.

  2. Install LocalSend on your phone.
    Android · Google Play iPhone · App Store

    Open LocalSend. If your iPhone asks for local network access, tap Allow.

  3. Install the same LocalSend app on your TV.

    Google TV · Open Search from the home screen and look for LocalSend.

    Android TV · Open Apps → Google Play Store and search for LocalSend.

    Select Install, then Open. Leave LocalSend open on the TV to receive the file.

  4. Send the file with LocalSend.

    In LocalSend on your phone, choose Send, select the downloaded APK, and choose your TV. Accept the transfer on the TV.

  5. Install SweepMyTV on your TV.

    Open the received file from LocalSend or find it in Downloads with your TV’s file manager. If prompted, allow the app opening the file to install apps. Select Install, then open Sweep TV from Apps.

Having trouble with LocalSend on the TV?

If it’s unavailable or your TV remote can’t navigate it, download directly in your TV’s browser if it supports file downloads.
